info.title: Aveline API
info.description: Event invitations, guest graph, ticketing and operations. See docs/API.md for conventions that apply across every endpoint.

name.description: Required when the invitee has no account yet

hostsLabel.description: Shown on the invitation. Defaults to the title.

templateKey.description: A template key from GET /events/:id/design-templates. Omitted picks the first active template, so an event always comes with a draft invitation.
Omitted picks the first active template

translations.description: Per-language title and hosts, edited one language at a time; null removes one

en.title: The wedding of Anna and Davit

remindersEnabled.description: Whether the automatic RSVP reminders go out. On by default; some hosts chase by phone and would rather we did not write to their guests.

visibility.description: PRIVATE is reachable only by invitation link. PUBLIC and UNLISTED allow a public listing and ticket sales. Making an event PRIVATE takes its listing down.

householdId.description: Join an existing household. Omitted creates a new one for this guest.

seatsAllotted.description: Seats for a new household. Ignored when joining an existing one.

householdId.description: Move the guest to another household on this event

enabled.description: Omit to leave the block enabled as-is

blocks.description: Blocks in their new display order

guestIds.description: Send only to these guests’ households. Omitted invites every household on the event that has not been invited yet.

note.description: A line from the host, added to the message, e.g. "We have moved to the garden."

value.description: TEXT/LONG_TEXT: a string. BOOLEAN: true or false. SINGLE_CHOICE: the position of the chosen option (0-based). MULTI_CHOICE: a list of positions.

guestId.description: A guest in the same household

answers.description: This member's own answers to the host's questions, e.g. their meal

status.description: Their answer; the respondent's if omitted

answers.description: Their own answers to the host's questions

attribution.description: Which host invited the guest. Recorded only if the host has not already said

members.description: Answers for others already named in the household. Those left out keep their answer.

party.description: People to add to the household. A name already in it is not added again.

notifyGuest.description: Send the guest the usual confirmation. Off by default: they told you themselves.

amountMinor.description: Amount in minor units, as a string

promoCode.description: A promo code to redeem, case-insensitive

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-supplied; makes a double-tapped checkout safe

priceMinor.description: Price in minor units, as a string. "0" is a free ticket.
Applies to future buyers; placed orders keep their price

isActive.description: false stops sales without deleting anything

slug.description: Public URL segment. Generated from the headline if omitted.

isIndexable.description: Allow search engines to index it. Off by default.

value.description: Percent 1–100, or an amount in minor units

eventId.description: Null applies the code to every event

planKey.description: A plan's key, as returned by GET /plans

returnUrl.description: Where the bank returns the payer

altText.description: Alt text keyed by locale, e.g. { "en": "Anna and Davit" }; null removes a language

capacity.description: Never below the guests already seated

posX.description: Canvas position, in the editor’s own units

position.description: Place at the table, for printed cards

briefScopes.description: Exactly what this vendor may read. Omitted uses the category default.

feeMinor.description: Agreed fee in minor units, as a string — whole drams for AMD
Agreed fee in minor units, as a string

kind.description: HOST for a couple, AGENCY for a planner
HOST for a couple, AGENCY for a planner

ownerEmail.description: The customer, invited as owner; they set their own password

palette.description: One of the template's palette names

options.description: Translated choices, for the choice types
Translated choices, for the choice types

venueId.description: Which of this event’s venues it happens at; null detaches it

isInternal.description: For the people running the day, not guests: vendors see it, the invitation does not

sortOrder.description: Breaks ties between entries at the same minute
